idea-plugin.name: Gosu Mutation Testing
idea-plugin.description:
Mutation testing for Gosu classes, from the IDE.
Right-click a .gs file and choose Run Mutation Testing: the class and its tests are copied into a separate trial project, mutated one change at a time and tested; the HTML report opens at the end. Original files are never modified. Tests can be files or whole folders, chosen once per class with Run Mutation Testing with Chosen Tests....
When the class depends on types that are not available, Build AI Stub Request prepares a request for an AI assistant (for example GitHub Copilot Chat in agent mode) to create minimal stand-in types.

action.description: Mutation test this Gosu class in a separate trial project
